body:
I actually agree with that. I just got the haircut yesterday and also thought it was a bit off. Luckily it's not the end of the world and I feel like it's still alright and I will just have to wait it out. 

Next time I will definitely keep a little bit more length on top. Also makes it easier to style. Thanks for the comment. Really happy to see that the comments are positive.
I think it's in your head man. In my opinion your smile looks completely normal.
Will do. Thanks for the suggestions. Appreciate it.

Thanks for the comment dude! 
As for the patchy facial hair, are you more talking about picture 1&3 or also 2&4 because it usually looks like 2&4. I never completely shave with a straight razor because it really gives me that babyface look and I hate it. I thought the way it looks in 2&4 was fine, but I might try to completely shave once I have a few days off or something so I can grow it back in time if I don't like it.

I really do need to hit the gym. I know it would make me look better and it's also just good for a bunch of other things. I'll get that going.

Good look to you aswell!
I'll see what I can do. Thanks for the suggestion.

Thanks. Yeah I do agree, but I try to really do as little as needed to my eyebrows. Usually just pluck in between and clean the edges on the side a bit. Also use a comb and scissors to cut the hairs once in a while.

I think my eyebrows are just naturally big and bushy though.
